en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a neatly landscaped public square surrounded by historic buildings and lush trees. There are well-maintained pathways, a central fountain or monument, and benches. The architectural style suggests early 20th-century Central Europe. The border of the photo contains the printed text 'Gruss aus Pyrmont' and 'Altenauplatz', along with handwritten notes. The reverse side shows German text, recipient information, a postmark dated 1905, and stamps including 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
